title: n=6 cycle-length scale-up of H_328: does the life vs consc signal sharpen at richer scale?
question: At n=6 (64 states, no fixed-point dominance), does the life vs consc ratio ≥ 2.0× hold AND the within-life heterogeneity (H_328 F328.3 fail) disappear?
engine: pure hexa-lang. n=6 periodic ECA ring. 64 starts × forward up to 70 steps, first-repeat cycle length detection.

rule_30_life.note: DRAMATIC drop from n=4 mean 6.25 — short-cycle at n=6

rule_110_life.note: DRAMATIC rise from n=4 mean 1.75 — class IV universality emerges at n≥6

comparison_n4_vs_n6.rotation: DOMINANCE FLIPS between rule_30 and rule_110 across n=4 → n=6

within_class.note: life class still single-dominant-rule (rule_110 alone) at n=6 — within-class heterogeneity NOT cured by scale-up; the dominant rule simply ROTATED from rule_30 (at n=4) to rule_110 (at n=6)

falsifier_eval.F333_2_WITHIN_LIFE_HOMOGENEOUS: FAIL — within_life_spread 6.75 (rule_110 dominates rule_30), still single-rule driven
falsifier_eval.F333_3_DOMINANT_RULE_PRESERVED: FAIL — dominance flips r30→r110 across n; the 'life class' is not a stable cycle-length leader
falsifier_eval.F333_4_SANITY_DIVERSE_BASELINES: PASS — 4 rules show 4 distinct means at n=6 (vs 3 ties at n=4)

verdict_derived: 🟢 SUPPORTED-CONDITIONAL — n=6 PRESERVES the aggregate ratio direction (life > consc by 2.92×) and IMPROVES per-rule resolution (4 distinct values vs 3 ties at n=4), but exposes a SCALE-ROTATION discovery: the dominant rule flips between rule_30 (n=4 chaotic class III) and rule_110 (n=6 universal class IV). The 'life class' label is not a stable cycle-length leader — it relabels the dominant rule depending on n. This refines H_327's 'scale matters' finding from yes/no to specific (which rule dominates is n-conditional).
structural_vs_dynamical: DYNAMICAL kernel + scale-rich (n=6 64 states). Confirms H_327 prediction: dynamical kernels at richer scale give cleaner signals than n=4. But the within-class heterogeneity persists, so 'life vs consc' is not a clean axis at any scale tested.
honest_limits: n=6 panel; n=8/10 may show further dominance rotation (rule 110 → rule 30 back, or new winner)
Cycle length is one descriptor; longest cycle vs longest transient differ
70-step forward cap; some n=6 cycles may exceed (but rule_110 mean 7.75 is well under)
Symmetric vs asymmetric rule classes (e.g. rule 110 is left-asymmetric) confound the 'life chaotic' label
discovery_note: scale-rotation finding은 'rule class label'(life·consc)이 *scale-invariant* 아님을 보임. 'consciousness rules' 라는 분류 자체가 specific n에서만 의미 가짐. H_320/H_325/H_328/H_330 family의 reversed finding이 사실 *scale-locked artifact* 일 가능성.
